note: Design v1.1 §6 prologue, 2016-05-24. m_* = the player's own thoughts (“我”的独白). Read by PrologueDirector; every line has an English pair.

bubble_boot.zh: 开机速度 23 秒，击败全国 99% 用户
bubble_boot.en: Booted in 23 s, faster than 99% of users nationwide

virus_body.zh:
木马名称：HEUR/QVM07.1.Malware.Gen
文件位置：C:\hongmengos\Temp\~0.tmp
危险等级：<color=#D23C2A>严重</color>

是否立即清理？
virus_body.en:
Threat: HEUR/QVM07.1.Malware.Gen
Location: C:\hongmengos\Temp\~0.tmp
Risk: <color=#D23C2A>Severe</color>

Clean it now?

m_virus.zh: 刚开机就报毒？清了清了。
m_virus.en: A virus right after boot? Clean it, clean it.

m_dodge_3.en: I clicked Yes. I know I did!

virus_ignored.zh: 已忽略 1 个风险。如需处理，请重新运行木马查杀。
virus_ignored.en: 1 risk ignored. Run a Trojan scan again to deal with it.

m_ignored.zh: ……算了。360 天天报毒，八成又是误报。
m_ignored.en: …Whatever. 360 cries wolf every day. Probably another false alarm.

m_txt.zh: 怎么凭空多出个记事本？
m_txt.en: Where did that text file come from?

m_hijack.zh: 我去，什么玩意儿在动我电脑？不会中病毒了吧？！
m_hijack.en: What the — something is using my computer? Is this a virus?!

bubble_safe.zh: 我的显卡在哪里.jpg：文件安全，未发现威胁
bubble_safe.en: 我的显卡在哪里.jpg: file is safe, no threats found

m_grab.zh: 怎么鼠标动不了啊！这是灰鸽子？现在病毒这么强吗？得赶紧关机！
m_grab.en: Why won't the mouse move?! Is this Grey Pigeon? Viruses can do this now? I have to shut it down!

txt_bios.zh: 别关机。你的主板 BIOS 正在被改写，SPI Flash 只写了一半。此时断电，固件校验必失败，开机无法 POST，不亮机、不进 BIOS，返厂也只能换板。
txt_bios.en: Don't shut down. Your motherboard BIOS is being rewritten and the SPI flash is only half done. Cut the power now and the firmware check will fail: no POST, no display, no BIOS. Even the factory could only replace the board.

m_who.zh: ？！你是谁？什么玩意儿？怎么能听见我说话？窃听我麦克风了？……等等，「别关机」——这不是今年那个勒索病毒的套路吗？
m_who.en: ?! Who are you? What is this? How can you hear me? Are you listening through my mic? … Wait, "don't shut down" — isn't that this year's ransomware trick?

m_reboot.en: …I shut it down, and it's still here?

burn_repair_3.zh: 又一次进行了漫长的维修……修电脑的师傅已经记住你了。
burn_repair_3.en: After yet another long repair… The repair guy knows you by name now.

m_still_2.zh: 主板都换了，他怎么还在？！
m_still_2.en: They replaced the motherboard. How is it still here?!

m_still_3.zh: 烧了这么多回了，他怎么还在……
m_still_3.en: It has burned so many times. How is it still here…

rar_trial.zh: 您的 40 天试用期已到期。

txt_poem.zh: 海内逢知己，天涯若比邻。感谢你愿意相信我。这份文件包是对你的信任的回报。仔细研究他，你不会后悔的。
txt_poem.en: A kindred soul met within the seas makes the ends of the earth next door. Thank you for trusting me. This package repays your trust. Study him closely; you won't regret it.

m_poem.zh: 图种？这玩意儿还有人用？……还有，不应该是「海内存知己」吗？这人儿语文咋学的……
m_poem.en: A file hidden in a picture? People still do that? … And isn't it "a kindred soul *kept* within the seas"? Who taught this guy Chinese…

m_number.zh: 从头到尾它就往地址栏里敲了串数字……那串数字是干嘛的？
m_number.en: From start to finish it only typed one long number into the address bar… What was that number for?

m_open_exe.en: It left a {exe} behind… Let's open it.

lz_first.zh: 在吗？1080 周五开卖，你还等评测不？
lz_first.en: You there? The 1080 goes on sale Friday. Still waiting for reviews?

lz_pick_odd.zh: 先不说这个，电脑刚刚出了点怪事
lz_pick_odd.en: Never mind that, something weird just happened to my computer

lz_odd_2.zh: 鼠标自己动、下了个压缩包……没弹广告也没锁文件？听着不像勒索。先别急着重装，打开看看是啥。有不会的问我。
lz_odd_2.en: The mouse moved by itself and downloaded an archive… no ads, no locked files? Doesn't sound like ransomware. Don't reinstall yet, open it and see what it is. Ask me if you get stuck.

lz_yes_1.en: Fine, let's see the reviews first.

lz_game_2.zh: 对了，你那台机器最近有啥问题，随时在这儿问我。
lz_game_2.en: By the way, if that machine of yours acts up, just ask me here.

setup_mood.zh: 4. 你希望它是什么性格（一句话）
setup_mood.en: 4. What personality do you want for it (one sentence)

setup_mood_hint.en: e.g. tough talk, soft heart, loves to snark

history.zh: i7-6700K 配 980 Ti，电源 650W 够吗？
history.en: i7-6700K with a 980 Ti, is a 650 W PSU enough?

history.zh: 够。别买杂牌，海盗船、安钛克随便挑。
history.en: Enough. Skip no-name brands, Corsair or Antec are fine.

history.zh: 海盗船 RM650 买了，点亮了，谢了。
history.en: Got a Corsair RM650, it lit up. Thanks.

history.zh: 点亮就好。风道别堵，980 Ti 满载挺烫的。
history.en: Good. Keep the airflow clear, a 980 Ti runs hot at full load.

history.zh: 黑魂 3 无名王者打了一晚上没过
history.en: Spent all night on the Nameless King in Dark Souls 3, still not through

history.zh: 二阶段别贪刀，往他左手边滚。
history.en: Don't get greedy in phase two. Roll to his left.

history.zh: 我们实验室就两张旧 K40，十几个人排队用。你一个人占一张 980 Ti，奢侈啊。
history.en: Our lab has two old K40s and a dozen people queuing for them. You, alone with a 980 Ti. Luxury.

history.zh: 我就打游戏的，又不炼丹。
history.en: I only play games, I don't train anything.

history.zh: 下个月新卡就出了，你那张 980 Ti 趁现在还能卖三千上下。
history.en: New cards are out next month. Your 980 Ti still sells for around three thousand now.
I'll wait for the launch reviews.

history.zh: 1080 发布会看了吗？说比泰坦还快。
history.en: Did you watch the 1080 reveal? Faster than a Titan, they say.
Wait for the 1070, the 1080 is pricey.
The 1080 goes on sale Friday. Are you getting one?

history.zh: 不抢。组里预算批不下来，先蹲 1070。
history.en: No. The group budget won't cover it. I'll wait for the 1070.
